verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents executing JavaScript and waiting for dynamic content before extraction, plus built-in scroll simulation for infinite-scroll pages, hooks for browser control, and session reuse for multi-step crawls. That covers scripting page interactions before content is returned. Clicking and filling inputs are only implied by generic JS execution, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documented click/fill-input actions, examples of interaction scripts, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can script page interactions like clicking, filling inputs, and scrolling before content is returned

citations.quote: Dynamic Crawling: Execute JS and wait for async or sync for dynamic content extraction.
Full-Page Scanning: Simulates scrolling to load and capture all dynamic content, perfect for infinite scroll pages.
Advanced Browser Control: Hooks, proxies, stealth modes, session re-use—fine-grained control.
Session Management: Preserve browser states and reuse them for multi-step crawling.
